pages.title: Superpartner Shard
pages.text: Supersymmetry pairs every boson with a fermion and every fermion with a boson. The lightest such partner, the neutralino, would be stable, invisible and heavy: an ideal candidate for dark matter. The shard is almost weightless in light but seems far heavier when you try to move it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Colliding the Standard Model matrix with dark matter through a dark matter lens, I searched for something that interacted only weakly. A heavy neutral partner appeared, and it matched dark matter perfectly.
